1. Octopuses have three hearts: two pump blood to the gills, one to the rest of the body.
2. Their blood is blue because it uses copper-based hemocyanin instead of iron-based hemoglobin.
3. Octopuses can change color and texture in milliseconds using specialized skin cells called chromatophores.
4. They have nine brains: one central brain and a mini-brain in each of their eight arms.
5. Each arm
